niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals (brand awareness vs direct response), budget, geography, measurement needs, and whether you want creative, programmatic buying, or direct publisher access. That said, here’s a practical way to choose plus a short list of well‑regarded options.

How to pick the right CTV agency
- Define your objective: awareness, consideration, app installs, conversions, etc.  
- Check experience in CTV campaigns similar to yours (industry, KPIs, budget).  
- Ask about their buying approach: programmatic DSPs, direct publisher buys (Roku, Hulu, Amazon), or hybrid.  
- Confirm platform relationships and access (Roku OneView, The Trade Desk, Amazon Ads, Hulu, etc.).  
- Measurement & attribution: third‑party verification, viewability, incrementality testing, cross‑device reach.  
- Creative capabilities: do they produce/optimize CTV ads and companion assets?  
- Transparency & reporting: real‑time dashboards, granular reporting, fee structure.  
- References & case studies, plus ability to run a pilot and iterate.

Well‑regarded agencies and partners to consider
- Global holding‑group teams with strong CTV capabilities: GroupM (Mindshare, Wavemaker), Omnicom (OMD, PHD), Publicis (Zenith, Spark Foundry), Dentsu (Carat, iProspect), IPG (Initiative, UM).  
- Programmatic DSPs/platforms and tech partners: The Trade Desk, Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads, Hulu/Disney ad sales.  
- CTV specialists and tech vendors: Simulmedia, Innovid (creative/ad‑serving/measurement), Cadent (addressable TV), Amobee, VideoAmp, 605, Finecast (EMEA).  
- Measurement/verification partners: Nielsen, Comscore, IAS/DoubleVerify, VideoAmp.

Next steps I can help with
- If you tell me your objective, budget range, target geography and audience, I can shortlist 3–5 agencies/platforms that match and suggest an RFP checklist.  
Would you like me to do that? If so, give me your campaign goal, budget, and where you want to run it.
